critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1112 lines — still worth splitting into routers (owners/goals, branding, advisor, auth) before next iteration.

POST /api/advisor/clients/invite returns the temp password in the response body — ensure it is never logged (currently audit() only writes 'Invited client login <email> for <cid>', which is fine). Consider also emailing the client a one-time link instead of surfacing the raw temp password to the advisor UI.

InviteClientInput has no password-strength policy for the GENERATED temp password; secrets.token_urlsafe(6) → ~8 chars after base64, prepended with 'Cmps-'. Entropy is OK (~48 bits) but length is short; consider token_urlsafe(10)+ for defense-in-depth.
Saved Views are stored per-browser in localStorage — not synced across devices for the same advisor. Fine for Iter14 but note for future (persist on user row).
OpportunitiesList re-reads localStorage only on mount; if the user opens two tabs, chip deletes in one tab won't reflect in the other until reload.
